result:
Both suites pass, and the working tree only has the intended, uncommitted changes.

## Summary

- Removed the committed `Documentation/examples/observations.txt` fixture (`git rm`).
- `crates/ucal/tests/json_surface.rs` and `manual_fields.rs` now write their own observation fixture to a uniquely-named temp file (process id + an atomic per-process counter) instead of reading the committed file — the unique name avoids reintroducing the 1.12.0 race, since it guards against both cross-process collisions (two test binaries) and cross-thread collisions (multiple tests in one binary calling the same helper concurrently, which the old fixed-name-in-temp-dir approach didn't).
- `xtask/src/examples.rs`'s manual generator (`gen-examples`/`check-docs`) now writes the same fixture content to the exact path the worked example names, via an `ObservationsFixture` guard that removes it on drop (including on early `?` return), so the manual can still be regenerated without a checked-in copy.
- Added a `.gitignore` entry for `Documentation/examples/observations.txt` as a safety net in case a run doesn't clean up.

Verified `cargo test -q -p ucal --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p xtask --no-fail-fast` both pass, and manually exercised `gen-examples`/`check-docs` (via a symlinked release binary, since this environment's `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` differs from the repo tree) to confirm the doc regenerates identically and the fixture doesn't linger. Nothing committed, per your instruction.
